text:
The Companion Animal Travel Desk has read your complaint carefully and is treating it with the urgency it deserves.

We understand that you are upset because your pet travel arrangements were handled poorly, the crate was not managed as expected, and the follow-up you received did not give you confidence that Aurelia Skyways was taking the matter seriously. Your concern is being heard clearly, and we recognize how stressful this is when a companion animal is involved.

We are reviewing the full sequence of events with the relevant airport and baggage teams so we can determine where the breakdown occurred and what corrective action is needed. We are also checking the handling notes for the crate, the transfer process, and any reports already entered by staff. If a crate has been lost, <<FACT F118>> In the meantime, please keep every receipt, tag, and written message connected to the trip, as these items help us move the review forward without delay.

Our approach is calm and stepwise, but it is not passive. If the matter requires escalation, it will be sent through the proper review path so the next team can assess the record and respond with a clear outcome. We will also look at whether service recovery is appropriate in light of the disruption you experienced.

Please be assured that the Companion Animal Travel Desk is advocating for a fair resolution and for clearer handling on future journeys. We want the record corrected, the communication improved, and your confidence in Aurelia Skyways restored.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
